# The back row: five buildings behind the roofs (fronts at glTF z -2.2, 1 m deep), lit windows,
# flat roofs with a teal cap, and the posts that carry the three searchlights. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Brick --base-color 0.388 0.106 0.204 --no-slot
